enunciado: Write a single insertion sort that uses a function-typed variable comesBefore(x, y) to decide the order. Sort {15, 3, 42, 8, 23} ascending, descending and by last digit.
objetivos: Separate the algorithm from the comparison criterion
pistas: The algorithm only asks whether the key comesBefore(key, a[j]).
Change the function stored in the variable before each call.
It is the same idea as the OOP Strategy pattern.
